description:
Terminal stories under the archived epics e095a100, 806eb14e, 2928ccce, d4851c3d still hold 21 artifacts outside `dev/archive/`. Re-running container archival on an archived epic collects its terminal stories' documents into the epic's existing marker-backed archive.

## Background

Per-epic story and artifact counts come from the 2026-10-01 preview record `dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/archive-preview-results.md`, which also showed a re-run on an archived epic previewing eligible into its existing directory.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Before execution, the archive preview of each listed epic reports it eligible with its existing marker-backed destination and no blocker.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each listed epic is re-archived through container archival, and its archive directory keeps a marker naming the epic's full identifier.
- [hard] REQ-03: Byte verification passes for every moved artifact, and each tracker document reference names the artifact's archive path.
- [hard] REQ-04: In-file citations to each moved path in READMEs, `AGENTS.md`, Rustdoc and `dev/active/` documents are repointed in the same change, because archival rewrites only document references; receipt directories and digest-pinned inputs keep their bytes.
- [hard] REQ-05: A rerun of each archive reports no change, a link scan of each archive directory and each repointed file reports no unresolved local link, and the manifest records each row as complete.

## Notes

Terminal stories under open epics are out of scope; they archive with their epic when it becomes terminal.
title: Re-archive epics e095a100, 806eb14e, 2928ccce, d4851c3d to collect their terminal stories
